system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: we also add a memory component mem that provides additional context to this agent
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only. The prompt is few-shot and adds reflection memory between trials. The rendering mechanism is not shown.

env_context_strategy.note: Paper only; no tool registry or task template available. The ReAct HotPotQA agent uses a Wikipedia API.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we truncate the agent’s memory to the last 3 self-reflections (experiences)
context_compaction.note: The self-reflection model distills trajectories into summaries. Memory is bounded to Ω (1-3) experiences.

observation_format.evidence_quote: AlfWorld is a suite of text-based environments

tool_call_format.note: Paper only; no action parser available.

tool_count.note: Paper only; no tool list available.

edit_primitive.note: Paper only. Code tasks generate function bodies; no edit tool is described.

tool_schema_source.note: Paper only; no tool schema available.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; no dependencies or source available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The Actor, Evaluator, and Self-Reflection models work together through trials in a loop until the Evaluator deems τt to be correct.
loop_primitives.note: The actor is ReAct or CoT depending on the task. The trial loop is Algorithm 1.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The agent can suggest a new action choice or even a new long-term plan.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: utilizing three distinct models: an Actor, denoted as Ma, which generates text and actions; anEvaluator model
multi_agent_topology.note: One agent with Actor, Evaluator and Self-Reflection model roles; no separate agents are described.

delegation_mechanism.note: Paper only; no agent factory available.

human_in_loop.note: Paper only; no run-loop code available.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the trajectory history serves as the short-term memory

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: maintain their own reflective text in an episodic memory buffer to induce better decision-making in subsequent trials
long_term_memory.note: Closest value. This is an in-context reflection buffer across trials of the same task, not a database. Persistence across runs is unclear.

self_verification.evidence_quote: self-evaluation such as binary classification using LLMs (decision-making) or self-written unit tests (programming)
self_verification.note: The evaluator varies by task: exact match, heuristic, LLM, or self-generated tests.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: whileMe not pass ort< max trials do
retry_policy.note: Retry continues until the evaluator passes, with a max trials cap.

rollback.note: Paper only. The paper describes an environment reset between trials, which is a harness-level reset.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: whileMe not pass ort< max trials do
termination_condition.note: The AlfWorld heuristic (repeated actions, more than 30 actions) triggers reflection and a new trial.

execution_isolation.note: Paper only. The paper advises using isolated execution environments.

permission_model.note: Paper only. The paper states that generated code is not validated before execution.
